subject: Intro: Aurelion exec handoff + proposed CTO/VP attendance for demo
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aurelion.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@aurelion.com>
Date: 2029-09-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec intro & demo — VP/CTO availability

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the product overview last week — the team and I found the performance numbers compelling. Leadership here (VP of Product and CTO) have asked to join the next demo so they can evaluate integration impact and timing.

Can we schedule a 45-minute demo + 15-minute exec Q&A during the week of Sept 16? Their calendars are tight; ideal windows are:
- Tue 9/17 between 9:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 9/18 between 13:00–16:00 PT

If those don't work, please propose two alternatives and we will try to free up the attendees. Also attaching a short scope note so your team knows what they want to see.

Priya
Director, Platform Partnerships
Aurelion Systems
Attachment: aurelion-demo-scope.pdf (pdf)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>

Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@aurelion.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-09-03T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro & demo — VP/CTO availability

Hi Priya — great to hear leadership is engaged.

Quick note on internal coverage: I want to make sure our engineering lead and product sponsor join for the Q&A to handle the integration and SLAs. I've copied Lauren (Product) and Rishi (Solutions) but will confirm their availability. Proposed plan: 45m demo followed by 15m exec Q&A, and we will prepare a 1-page exec briefing focused on ROI and integration points.

From our side, these windows would work:
- Tue 9/17 10:00–11:00 PT (primary)
- Wed 9/18 14:00–15:00 PT (backup)

If either of those line up with your VP/CTO, we can lock it and I'll send a calendar invite. If they'd prefer an early-morning deep-dive followed by a short exec touchpoint, we can do a separate 30m technical dry run before the exec slot.

Also looping in Rishi for prep materials — Rishi, can you produce a one-slide integration map and a short latency/cost Q&A doc by Fri 9/6?

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Mateo — thanks. The VP (Anika Verma) confirmed Tue 9/17 10:00–11:00 PT; CTO (Daniel Cho) will attend if we can keep the agenda tight and leave 10–15 minutes for architecture questions. They prefer to avoid a separate dry run unless a technical lead is needed; having your eng lead on the call should be sufficient.

Please confirm you can include:

- 30-minute demo focused on integration patterns and latency/cost 
- 15-minute live Q&A (with engineering and prod)

We have a brief NDA in place so no additional paperwork needed. I can accept the calendar invite once confirmed.

Priya
